description: This file contains the implementation of helper functions related to HTTP headers, methods, CGI environment variables, media types, and time retrieval. It provides functions to map between names and internal IDs, fetch reason phrases, media types, subtypes based on file extensions, and obtain system clock and UTC times. The functions are part of a module supporting the Http Basic Message Object, likely used internally within a larger HTTP server or client implementation.

methods.name: ULONG HttpHcoGetHeaderId(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,char * name)
methods.description: Retrieves the atom code (ID) associated with a given HTTP header name using the internal header atom object.

methods.name: char * HttpHcoGetHeaderName(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,ULONG ulHeaderId)
methods.description: Retrieves the name of an HTTP header corresponding to a given header ID from the internal header atom object.

methods.name: ULONG HttpHcoGetMethodId(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,char * name)
methods.description: Retrieves the atom code (ID) for a given HTTP request method name via the internal method atom object.

methods.name: char * HttpHcoGetMethodName(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,ULONG ulMethodId)
methods.description: Retrieves the method name associated with a given method ID from the internal method atom object.

methods.name: ULONG HttpHcoGetCgiEnvId(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,char * name)
methods.description: Gets the atom code (ID) for a named CGI environment variable from the internal CGI environment atom object.

methods.name: char * HttpHcoGetReasonPhrase(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,ULONG code)
methods.description: Returns the reason phrase string associated with a given HTTP response status code.

methods.name: ULONG HttpHcoGetExtMediaType(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,char * file_ext)
methods.description: Returns the media type atom code for a file extension after converting it to lowercase.

methods.name: ULONG HttpHcoGetExtSubType(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,char * file_ext)
methods.description: Returns the subtype atom code for a file extension after converting it to lowercase.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS HttpHcoGetClockTime(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,ANSC_HANDLE hTime)
methods.description: Retrieves the current system clock time into the provided time structure.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS HttpHcoGetUtcTime(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,ANSC_HANDLE hTime)
methods.description: Retrieves the current UTC time into the provided time structure.
